decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a long-cycle defense niche with heavy qualification investment and few alternative uses, so management will persist even though the product is only mentioned on the website, attributing slow uptake to long naval procurement cycles.

The medical examination light has a dedicated page, and certification costs are already sunk, so visible commitment and investment in regulatory approval favor keeping it while early results are judged temporary.
Explosion-proof luminaires require costly ATEX certification and fit the firm's industrial lighting direction, so the sunk investment and strategic centrality strongly favor persistence.
The designer task light was publicly announced as a relaunch of a popular product, a public commitment management would want to justify, so it stays on the market.
